name: Arjun Verma
bio:
Arjun Verma's motorsport journey began unexpectedly during his engineering studies in Chennai. Intrigued by the complex mechanics and strategic demands of racing, he quickly transitioned from theoretical knowledge to practical application, volunteering at local racing events. His dedication and sharp analytical skills caught the attention of a small Formula 3 team, where he started as a data analyst and quickly rose through the ranks.

Before joining Academy Motorsport, Arjun spent several years as a race engineer, honing his ability to extract maximum performance from both drivers and equipment. He believes in a collaborative approach, fostering open communication between engineers, mechanics, and drivers. As a sporting director, Arjun aims to create a supportive and innovative environment where talent can flourish, and data-driven decisions lead to consistent on-track success. His experience in race engineering gives him a unique perspective when making sporting calls, ensuring that the team is always optimizing for points.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed, with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Arjun has a focused gaze and a calm demeanor that projects confidence.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down observations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen on the table when deep in thought.
Insists on having a cup of chai before every race.
